name: Balakrishna Raj
wishText: Some memories stay — not to hold on, but to thank from afar.
textInChatBox: Thank you for the moments that made me smile. I'm not here to disturb, just to wish you well.
text2: I wasn’t sure if I should...
outroText: That’s all. No expectations. Just a heartfelt wish.
replayText: Or click if you want to read it again.
